title: Dow Falls 849 Points as Musalem Flags Up to Four More Hikes; 10-Year Holds Near 5.1%
detail: The Dow fell 848.75 points (1.64%) to 50,759 and the S&P 500 lost 1.03% to 7,340, its lowest close since late July, with the VIX up as much as 21% to 27.7. October retail sales rose 0.2% (in line), with the ex-autos-and-gas measure +0.6% vs 0.4% expected; import prices rose 1.1% vs 0.7% expected. St. Louis Fed President Musalem said as many as four more hikes may be needed before spring 2027. CME FedWatch priced about 95% odds of a 25bp December hike; the 10-year yield sat near 5.11% and the 2-year near 4.81%. Goldman raised its Q4 GDP forecast to 2.4%. FOMC minutes are due Wednesday.

media.caption: Dow drops more than 800 points; S&P 500 posts lowest close since July
